summary: Full-stack test of TukangGaji Pro V2 (FastAPI + Expo web preview). Backend: 25/25 pytest passed (auth admin+worker, worker CRUD + duplicate-name 409, attendance tap flow + edit with no-rest toggles = Rp 215.000, payroll period 2 TG001 215.000/100.000/115.000, mandor payment validation, role guards 401/403, xlsx exports valid PK zip). Frontend: ~45 UI checks across login, admin dashboard, pekerja CRUD (create with green credential panel TG002/PIN, duplicate rejection, edit rates, reset PIN 0916 + login verified), absensi tap Masuk>Istirahat>Lembur>Pulang with correct state machine and aria-disabled, edit sheet with toggles (11j reguler, Rp 215.000) and delete record, gaji month/period/group navigation, multi-select pay bar, mandor payment (name required 422, recorded, history, deleted), Excel downloads confirmed (gaji-2026-09-periode2.xlsx, absensi-2026-09-periode2.xlsx), worker view-only screens all correct (no edit/tap controls), logout both roles. One real frontend bug found: missing role guard on web reload of sub-routes. Test data cleaned up; seeded TG001 data verified intact.

minor.issue: next_worker_code uses count+1; concurrent creates could race (unique index on code protects data, request would 500). Low risk at this scale.
ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD use hardcoded fallbacks instead of failing fast on missing env.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate-name error banner renders behind the open bottom-sheet overlay (dimmed, partially obscured). Visible but UX could be improved by showing error inside the sheet.

integration_issues.flow: Web reload / deep link on sub-route
integration_issues.issue: No role-based route guard in (admin)/_layout.tsx and (worker)/_layout.tsx. Reloading /gaji as worker TG001 rendered the ADMIN Gaji screen (Rekap & bayar, admin tabs) which called admin APIs and showed 403 'Khusus admin' banner - broken mixed state. Expo Router resolves /gaji to the first matching group ((admin)) regardless of session role. Root '/' Gate redirect works correctly.

action_items: Add role guard: in (admin)/_layout.tsx redirect to /(worker) or /login when session.role !== 'admin', and mirror in (worker)/_layout.tsx, so web reload/deep-link on shared paths (/absensi, /gaji) cannot render the wrong role's screens.
Optional: surface form errors (e.g. duplicate name 409) inside the bottom sheet instead of the page-level banner hidden behind the sheet overlay.
Optional: split server.py (822 lines) into routers (auth, workers, attendance, payroll, export).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend solid: JWT role guards enforced (worker->admin 403, no-token 401, export token query param admin-only), Mongo _id excluded everywhere, pin_hash never leaked, Pydantic validation incl. PIN regex, duplicate name check case-insensitive, soft-delete worker when attendance exists.
Payroll math verified end-to-end: 07:00-20:30 with both no-rest toggles = 11j reguler x 15.000 + 2,5j lembur x 20.000 = Rp 215.000; without toggles 8,5j = Rp 177.500.
Note: pytest -n auto (xdist default in env) can double-run module fixtures; run with -n0 (tests pass 25/25 with -n0; fixture tolerates duplicates).

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all core flows pass; 1 route-guard defect + 1 minor banner-behind-sheet issue)

Seeded TG001 Budi Santoso, today's attendance (215.000) and Pak RT 100.000 payment verified intact after cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: cd /app && python3 -m pytest backend/tests/ -n0 -v. Credentials: admin/tukangpro123, worker TG001/0907. Public URL in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). RN web gotchas for Playwright: Pressable disabled renders aria-disabled (is_disabled() won't work); Switch testID element has no aria-checked - use presence of conditional fields as state signal; sheet content needs scrollIntoView before clicking lower elements; tab bar items are role=tab links (use get_by_text exact). Known open defect: web reload on /gaji or /absensi renders admin screens for worker sessions (no role guard in group layouts).
rca_of_issue: Bug: worker session reloading web on /gaji sees admin Gaji screen with 403 'Khusus admin'. Repro: login as TG001/0907, open Gaji tab, page.reload(). Root cause: app/index.tsx Gate redirects by role only for '/', but (admin) and (worker) groups share identical sub-route names (absensi, gaji); Expo Router resolves /gaji to (admin)/gaji regardless of role and neither group layout checks session role. Mitigation: add useAuth role check + <Redirect> in both group _layout.tsx files.
